name: Vista Voice Skin
description: A Windows Vista style voice skin: an Aero glass window over the Vista Home Assistant theme's aurora wallpaper, a chrome microphone, task dialog text, the green glossy progress bar as the voice meter and a Home Assistant start orb. Follows Kiosk Satellite's light and dark modes.
author: wxcyber

settings.description: The text in the glass title bar and on the taskbar button.

settings.description: Draw the black glass taskbar with a clock along the bottom of the full screen look.
